result.subject: Request for a 30-Minute Lab Tour During Student Expedition
result.body:
Your recent work on medical robotics at Fudan University has significantly advanced surgical trajectory planning. We are a small group of engineering students visiting Shanghai to explore cutting-edge research in biomedical engineering. We write to seek your guidance on how your work influences current practices in the field.

We are particularly interested in your research on surgical trajectory planning and its application in robotic-assisted surgery. Our group hopes to understand the technical challenges and innovations in this area to inform our final project. Your insights would greatly enhance our understanding of the practical implications of your research.

We would be honored to request a 30-minute lab tour during our visit. We are flexible with your schedule and can adapt to any time that suits your availability. Thank you for considering our request.
